item.title: First-ever in-utero stem cell therapy for fetal spina bifida repair is safe
item.description:
📝 (SACRAMENTO) A UC Davis Health research team has safely performed the world’s first spina bifida treatment combining fetal surgery with stem cells, according to results from Phase 1 of an ongoing clinical trial. Key Phase 1 findings The first six babies in the trial were monitored closely from surgery through birth. Researchers reported: No safety concerns related to the stem cells.
🔗 Read more: https://health.ucdavis.edu/news/headlines/first-ever-in-utero-stem-cell-therapy-for-fetal-spina-bifida-repair-is-safe-study-finds/2026/02

Plastic is made from milk and it vanishes in 13 weeks
item.description:
📝 Science News from research organizations This plastic is made from milk and it vanishes in 13 weeks Milk protein and clay team up to create a plastic-like film that vanishes in soil in just 13 weeks. Date: February 28, 2026 Source: Flinders University Summary: Scientists racing to tackle plastic pollution have created a surprising new contender: a biodegradable packaging film made partly from milk protein. Researchers at Flinders University blended calcium caseinate with starch and natural nanoclay to form a thin, durable material designed to mimic everyday plastic.
🔗 Read more: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/02/260227071922.htm
